scope: Original-practice Q24-Q25 bounded author-side primary-source audit

questions.stem: Which statement about globalisation is correct?

options.A: FDI, trade and technology integration have different transmission channels
options.B: FDI equity and total FDI inflow are identical
options.C: Globalisation removes all need for domestic regulation
options.D: Every export automatically benefits every district equally

assessment.A: Conceptually defensible: FDI, trade and technology diffusion are distinct mechanisms; direct comprehensive official treatment of all three channels not opened.
assessment.B: False: RBI balance-of-payments tables distinguish equity, reinvested earnings and other capital within inward FDI.
assessment.C: False as a categorical claim; no primary regulation-specific source opened for complete independent certification.
assessment.D: False as a categorical universal claim; district-level incidence requires empirical evidence, not established by export status.

questions.result: KEY_RETAINED_BOUNDED; all distractors not primary-source certified

questions.stem: A state publishes a 2047 growth vision after the Twelfth Five-Year Plan ended. Which inference is justified?

options.A: The vision itself establishes that the projected 2047 GSDP has already been achieved
options.B: NITI Aayog must approve a Thirteenth Five-Year Plan before the state can prepare budgets
options.C: Formal national Five-Year Plans ended, but state strategies still require financing and outcome verification
options.D: The vision automatically substitutes for audited expenditure accounts and independent impact evaluation

assessment.A: False: future projection is not a realised outcome; no specific state GSDP independently checked.
assessment.B: False: NITI Aayog identifies Twelfth Plan as final and a shift to vision/strategy/action agenda; no Thirteenth Plan approval requirement established.
assessment.C: Supported in its chronology by NITI Aayog statement that Twelfth Plan was last; financing and outcome verification are evaluation principles, not evidence that any particular state vision has secured funding.
assessment.D: False: strategic vision is not an audited expenditure account; original audit-law source not independently opened.
